about_the_game:
Overview

This game is an exploration action game in which a boy who has obtained a special diving suit travels around a vast underwater world, defeating the enemies that stand in his way as he heads for the deep sea.

Living in a world where most of the land has sunk into the sea due to the rising sea level, the boy encounters a special diving suit - called 'Magear' - from a bygone era and acquires the power to swim freely underwater. He expands his exploration area by using Magear and digging up lost technologies that have sunk to the bottom of the sea. Then, he will enter the deep sea where the truth of the world awaits him.

Features

  • Speedy and exhilarating acrobatic combat in which players swim freely underwater.
  • Expand your exploration area by enhancing your diving suit and explore the vast underwater world.
  • Additional actions gained by enhancing your diving suit make combat more profound and stylish.
  • Unique creatures adapted to the deep-sea environment stand in your way.
  • Fascinating divers using Magear to cooperate/oppose.
  • Reveal the truth of the world hidden in the deep sea.
